sentences.text:
"It is submitted that the respondent herein has filed the complaint before 6th ACMM,
Bengaluru u/s 498A, 504, 506, 114, 323 r/w 34 of IPC r/w 3, 4 of D.P.Act against the petitioner.
c.C.No.29687/2021 pending before 6th ACMM, Bengaluru.

Further the respondent has also filed a case for restitution of conjugal rights against the petitioner pending before 3rd Family Court vide M.C.No.4997/2021."
4.

In light of the settlement arrived between the parties and the offences being the ones punishable under Section 498A, 504 and 506 of IPC, I deem it appropriate to NC: 2023:KHC:19026 accept the settlement and terminate the proceedings against the petitioners in C.C.No.29687/2021.
5.
Learned counsel for the petitioners hands over a demand draft of Rs.2,00,000/- in furtherance of aforequoted settlement.
The same is acknowledged by respondent No.2 who is present before the Court.

6. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER i.
Criminal petition stands disposed of.
ii. The proceedings in C.C.No.29687/2021 on the file of VI Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru stands quashed.
